seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: H axis = block row with most wall-10 corners, V axis = column with most; pieces ring 5, targets any block containing 11.
Selection = wall-10 block off the intersection with a 0 centre (H or V), else first piece with a 0 centre; A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (min block) -> H.
A1/A2 move selected H axis or piece up/down; A3/A4 move V axis or piece left/right; pieces blocked by board edge and other pieces.
Each piece block mirrors across V, H and both into visible gray 4 blocks; render piece>refl>target>wall; HUD col 63 gains one 12 per effective action, no-op returns frame unchanged.
Fully stateless; unconfirmed: axes pass freely under pieces/targets.
